name: laser
what: Terran laser: two detuned saws and a sine an octave under them diving from 1.25 kHz through a closing filter, a soft dull click on the front

name: laser_t
what: the laser turret: the laser a fourth lower and longer

name: particle
what: particle cannon: an old western's ricochet off a spark: a soft arc and its spits, a ping, a whine falling 3 kHz to 650 Hz as the slug tumbles away

name: particle_t
what: particle turret, anti-capital: the particle cannon's ricochet an octave down, longer

name: ion
what: ion cannon: a deep FM plasma whomp, its vibrato quick, a sub under it

name: disruptor
what: disruptor: two saws sweeping past each other (the phasing) through a resonant band

name: massdriver
what: mass driver: kinetic: between a chunk and a chuck: a ch of noise, a falling thump and a resonant knock, no ringing metal; as loud as the laser

name: photon2
what: Aera Photon II: an FM bell with inharmonic partials, falling, a breath of noise

name: photon3
what: Aera Photon III: the light bell, fast and high

name: penetrator
what: Aera penetrator: the heavy bell, a tearing chopped noise, a sub

name: ktek
what: Rlaan Ktek: breathy organic fire: noise through two formants sliding eee to yow, a pulse under it

name: kbeam
what: Rlaan Ktek beam: a beating saw drone, its filter wobbling, crackle over it

name: crippler
what: Rlaan crippler: a warbling square, its pitch shaking

name: thumper
what: Rlaan grav thumper: a sub thump diving, a click, a rumble

name: lbeam
what: Aera long particle beam: the buzzing drone higher and harder

name: gauss
what: Aera grand gauss, a capital ship's main gun: a crack and a long falling thump

name: icepick
what: Rlaan icepick: a tick and a falling zing

name: launch
what: a missile away: ignition, then the roar of its motor going

name: torpedo
what: a torpedo away: a clunk of its release, then a deep slow roar

name: rocket
what: a rocket pod: a short whoosh

name: mine
what: a mine dropped: a clunk and a falling beep

name: boom_small
what: a missile's burst, a small explosion: a crack, a falling roar, a sub thump, crackles

name: boom_ship
what: a fighter destroyed: the crack, then a rolling roar, debris crackling

name: boom_capital
what: a capital ship destroyed: bursts over a long deep roar

name: hit_shield
what: a hit on the player's shields: a soft electric thump, a fizz in a 2.2 kHz band, a low hum

name: hit_hull
what: a hit on the player's hull: a metal crunch, a thud, a light rattle

name: hit_far
what: a hit on another ship: a short dull pop

name: spark
what: a system breaking in the cockpit: a sharp electric arc, spits of sparks ringing as they land, a buzz; quiet, at about the laser's level

name: klaxon
what: the hull is gone: a two-tone klaxon, again and again while the reserve lasts

name: wrecked
what: a system destroyed: a heavy clunk, a dying whine as it goes

name: pa_report
what: the ship's address system once the host's mission has begun: a two-note chime, then All pilots, report to the briefing room through a tinny speaker and a hall's echo (art/voice: eSpeak NG)

name: comm_cut
what: a comm cut off, its speaker killed: a squelch click, a radio hiss in a speaker's band broken up and crackling, gone in under half a second
